name: Vein Mining
description: Hold the tilde key to show the terrain material under the crosshair. While held, mining chains to clear matching minerals within a 5-meter sphere of the actual hit point. Configure the material whitelist with materialIds in config.txt; the default keeps the original 33 entries and adds ID 93 for underwater glowing soil. Restart the game after changes. Supports 10-meter pickaxe reach and host/client multiplayer requests; both players should use the same configuration. Compatible with game build 1076226.
